name: Padded gambeson
description: Layers of quilted linen. It is surprisingly good at stopping a blow and unsurprisingly bad at smelling nice.
notes: Light body armor: padded cloth at the top of the cloth weight range. Weight 2.5 kg (ADR-0003 reference weights). Catalogue tier common (economy doc, body armor light 90-140). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
